# MQ16YuslanKneelFix

**Ships:** recompiled `Scripts/_00E_MQ16_Functions.pex` (+ source), script-only, generated by
`src/MQ16YuslanKneelFix/tools/01-build-yuslan-kneel-fix.py`. The live copy is in
`Zenderal - Patch Collection`. **Status:** built and deployed 2026-11-14. SureAI's 2.1.4.4 source rebuilds
to the shipped `.pex` (626 strings); the fork keeps all of them and the same 185 properties, plus the
watchdog's 94 new strings. **Unverified in game. The cause of the stall is not known yet.** Like
[`PrologueRopeFix`](PrologueRopeFix.md), this is a watchdog plus a trace.

## The report

Longinus (Discord, 2026-11-14, *"Can't continue the shards of order part 2"*): in the City of a Thousand
Floods, *"Calia said the corpse should be decaying. Yuslan said 'Good Question' and I'm stuck nothing is
happening"*. Reloading the save several times did not help; **`disable` + `enable` on Yuslan in the
console did.**

## How the scene works (base Enderal 2.1.4.4)

Quest `MQ16 07FA94` (*The Shards of Order, Part II*), scene `MQ16_SC04_Journey_04 147193` in cell
`MQ16CityOfFloodsCavern 11C4DC`. Started by `StartSC04()` (stage fragment), which makes Tealor, Yuslan
and the companion followers again. Alias 3 = Yuslan, `_00E_MC_YuslanRef 102DED` (base `1080CF`).

| Phase | Completes when | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | player < 500 from the companion **and** Tealor's escort package done | on completion: `DisableFollower_SC04()` (no longer followers) |
| 1 | (no condition) | player line `1470C6` / Calia `1470C5` (*"…They should have decayed long ago."*); Yuslan walks to `14719B` (`MQ16_SC04_YuslanInspect 14719D`) |
| 2 | action 4 done | Yuslan: *"Good question."* (`1470CA`) |
| **3** | **alias 3 `IsInFurnitureState Sit`** | Yuslan's package `MQ16_SC04_SitTarget 1471B7` (template `SitTarget 0A9277`, phases 3–8): kneel at `KneelingMarker 0E8E4E` ref **`1471B6`** (13067, −369, −4850), 43 units from the fourth corpse `1471B3` |
| 4 | (no condition) | Yuslan `1470C4` (*"Hm... It looks like magic to me…"*, action 20) |
| 5–8 | topic actions | player/Calia, Yuslan ×2, Tealor `1470C7`; on phase 8's end stage 60 |

So **phase 3 has no timeout**: if Yuslan never ends up in furniture state Sit, the scene waits forever.
That matches the report exactly: the last line heard is phase 2's.

## What the list does to it

Nothing found. **[verified 2026-11-14]**

- **Records:** binary scan of all 477 plugins in Ultra: `MQ16`, the scene, all six packages it runs, the
  `SitTarget` template, `KneelingMarker` and its keywords (`isKneeling 0E8E4F`, `FurnitureSpecial`,
  interaction keyword `ActorTypeNPC`), the marker ref, the cell, its navmesh `12AB1B`, Yuslan's ref and
  the scene's topics are all defined only by `Skyrim.esm`. No plugin adds a ref to the cell. The corpse
  base `1471E1` is overridden only by PG Patcher's `PG_1.esp`.
- **Yuslan's NPC record** wins from `MB - EGO.esp` (chain: FS, EGO, Malphas' Blessing, MB - EGO): stats,
  perks, a silver steel sword, combat style, Malphas' face and skin. Race (`033898`), packages, outfit and
  flags are FS's. Nothing that stops furniture use.
- **Meshes:** no mod ships `Furniture\IdleKneeling.nif`.
- **Animations:** the only kneel replacers are Immersive Interactions' DAR folders `19931`–`19937`
  (`idlekneelenter/idle/exit`), gated on its global `AR_DogUp 00AA13` = 1–7. That is a global, so while
  it is non-zero it would swap **every** actor's kneel, but it is 0 at rest and a stuck global would not
  be cured by disable/enable. The list's Pandora output keeps the four human kneel animation sets as
  the template plus `zpairset`'s six paired clips (nothing removed).
- No mod ships `_00E_MQ16_*.pex` or `SF_MQ16_SC04*.pex` loose.

**Reading:** the static data is vanilla, a reload did not help and a disable/enable did. Disable/enable
rebuilds Yuslan's 3D and animation graph and resets his AI; a reload restores both from the save. So
Yuslan was most likely carrying a stuck **runtime** state (animation-graph variables are saved in the
`.ess`, see the shield `bAttached` case) that refused the kneel entry. Which state is open; the watchdog
logs the usual suspects.

## The fix

SureAI's script unchanged except one call at the end of `DisableFollower_SC04()` (phase 0's end), which
starts a 1 s watchdog on the quest (non-property variables only; the quest had no `OnUpdate` anywhere,
nor does its fragment script `QF_MQ16_0007FA94`). It:

- runs while the scene plays, action 20 (Yuslan's phase 4 line) is not done and the stage is < 60; it
  counts once action 4 (*"Good question."*) is done, so it times phases 3–4;
- logs on entering phase 3 and at every step: Yuslan's sit state, current package, position, distance
  to the marker (and the player's, Tealor's, Calia's, the companion's), weapon drawn, combat state,
  bleedout/unconscious, both hands' items, graph variables (`bAnimationDriven`, `IsEquipping`,
  `IsUnequipping`, `IsStaggering`, `IsBlocking`, `bInJumpState`, `bIsSynced`, `iState`) and scene
  actions 4/19/20;
- while Yuslan is **not** sitting (`GetSitState() != 3`): 12 s → `EvaluatePackage`; 20 s → sheathe if
  drawn, `IdleForceDefaultState`, `EvaluatePackage`; 30 s → `Disable`/`Enable` (the console fix);
  45 s → `MoveTo` the marker and `Activate` it with Yuslan; 60 s → `Disable`/`Enable` again; then a
  `STALL` line every 30 s;
- if he **is** sitting for 40 s with no line (the scene does not see him seated; his line takes ~6 s
  once he kneels), one `Disable`/`Enable`;
- registers its next tick before doing anything, with an in-tick guard for the latent `Wait`.

A normal run kneels within ~5 s and ends the watch with no step taken.

**Not covered:** a save made *during* phases 1–3 already passed `DisableFollower_SC04`, so the watch never
starts there. Those players use the console fix below. A save from before the cavern scene is covered.

## Testing / next step

Log lines start with `[ZP MQ16 kneel]` in `My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\Logs\Script\Papyrus.0.log`
(OneDrive variant possible). The `watch ended` line gives the seconds spent in phases 3–4 and not
kneeling; a run with any step shows which state Yuslan was in. **Longinus's save from before the
disable/enable** would show the stuck state directly (graph variables diff against a working save).

Console escape without this fix: `prid 102DED`, `disable`, `enable`.

## Build

```
python src/MQ16YuslanKneelFix/tools/01-build-yuslan-kneel-fix.py
```

Then copy `Scripts/compiled/_00E_MQ16_Functions.pex` to Patch Collection's `Scripts/` and the source to
`Scripts/Source/`. The tool puts the fork's own folder **first** on the compiler's import path: without
it, the compiler compiled SureAI's copy of the same name and reported success (this tool's first run;
see [`papyrus.md`](../workspace/papyrus.md)). It asserts the watchdog's strings are in the `.pex`.
